name: Taming the Beast
summary: In Durotar, Taming the Beast sends young hunters to the coast for their second trial. Thotar, the hunter trainer in Razor Hill, directs aspiring orc and troll hunters to pacify a surf crawler near the Echo Isles and extend their bond to coastal wildlife.

sections.title: Bonding with the Coast
sections.body: After mastering a dire mottled boar, you turn your attention to the sea at Thotar's direction. Durotar's harsh shores are jagged, and shallow reefs teem with armored crustaceans. A surf crawler resists intrusion into its coastal domain, so taming one calls for patience and fortitude.

sections.title: The Extension of Will
sections.body: Thotar teaches that a bound beast must become an extension of a hunter's strength. Subduing a surf crawler with the taming rod teaches you to command creatures of different temperaments in different surroundings. It proves you are ready for permanent companions.

faq.answer: Surf crawlers skitter through the shallows along Durotar's eastern shores, across from Sen'jin Village, near the waters leading toward the Echo Isles.

faq.q: What is the purpose of taming a surf crawler?
faq.answer: Thotar assigns a surf crawler to teach you to command different kinds of beasts. Taming an armored aquatic creature broadens your control and proves you can master animals from water as well as dry land.

faq.q: Do I keep the surf crawler permanently?
faq.answer: No. The beasts you tame in these first trials are temporary practice subjects, subdued with Thotar's taming rod. Only after completing the full series do you learn the permanent taming skill.
Thotar, the hunter trainer in Razor Hill, gives you this trial after you prove you can tame a dire mottled boar.

faq.q: What comes after taming the surf crawler?
faq.answer: After you return the rod to Thotar, he gives you a third and final trial: track down and tame an Armored Scorpid. Then he teaches you permanent beast mastery.

faq.q: Why use a taming rod instead of natural skills?
faq.answer: Novice hunters have not yet developed the spiritual authority to bond wild beasts permanently. The taming rod lets beginners safely practice channeling their will before they learn the true technique.

angles.text: As a hunter, you learn the discipline needed to command defensive beasts. A creature's natural armor and tenacity can complement your skill as a ranged marksman.
As an orc making a permanent home in Durotar, you reinforce your mastery of the rugged land by subduing its hardy shoreline wildlife.
As a Darkspear troll, you know the waters near the Echo Isles and Sen'jin Village well. This trial brings you face to face with wildlife from your coastal refuge.
